components.name: Doge Palace frontage
components.scope: 66m mapped canal-front segment, 16 ground arches,32 upper pointed arches and quatrefoils, pale/pink nested diamond inlay and central balcony. Two neighboring wings distinct; south wing cut around upper route. Scale/topology corrected; sculptural accuracy and full material realism remain unverified.

components.name: Venetian and Venezia towers
components.scope: Replace generic grids with source-fitted setbacks, arched crowns, cream wall piers and dark glazing. Preserve existing guest rooms and collision. October 9: continuous arched glass strips, salmon/taupe piers, crown and cornices installed at inherited outlines/heights. Full massing survey pending.

components.name: Campanile
components.scope: Refit shaft/belfry/roof proportions and ornament. Existing tower remains; texture and silhouette require refinement. October 9: dimensional arches, column orders, balustrades and cornices installed. Inherited footprints/heights, photo-estimated detail. Figurative reliefs, exact storefront arrangements and matched-camera proportions remain unverified. Muted brick and pale patina roof updated against close aerial; relief/statuary still approximate.

components.name: Outdoor canal and promenades
components.scope: Mapped two water basins and T-shaped public plaza, geometric paving, graded street/lobby connections, colliding balustrades, column and kiosk silhouettes. Exact physical heights and decorative details remain provisional.

components.name: Rialto bridge and upper entrance
components.scope: Improve covered bridge architecture while preserving playable landing and upper door. Covered inclined arcade and pavilion added around preserved seven-metre stair lane and 6.24 m upper landing. Visible arched masonry underside added; full two-sided span and road underpass clearance remain unverified. Escalator mechanics and statuary not implemented.

components.name: Adjoining palazzi and restaurant frontage
components.scope: Replace repeated arched boxes with photograph-matched bays, balconies, cornices and outdoor dining. October 9: dimensional arches, column orders, balustrades and cornices installed. Inherited footprints/heights, photo-estimated detail. Figurative reliefs, exact storefront arrangements and matched-camera proportions remain unverified.

components.name: Pool decks and resort grounds
components.scope: Survey full site and levels; include landscaping, pools, terraces and service facades. Main four-pool roof deck geometry now installed, map-derived shapes with cabanas, loungers and estimated Spritz pavilion. Registration/elevation provisional. Missing South Tower Pool Garden, hedges, exact dining frontage, accessible interior connection and Palazzo deck. Square palm planters and near-detail pinnate foliage now installed; exact spacing/crowns provisional. South Tower Pool Garden first geometry pass installed: central basin with octagonal dry island, three spas, paving, clipped beds/chaises and balustrades. Earlier missing-Pool-Garden note superseded by this partial pass. Height34m/map registration estimated; chapel/Bouchon garden facades/access unresolved. Palazzo seven-pool first geometry pass now installed: rounded basins/openings, coping, mosaic floor bands, cabanas, chaise banks and estimated Capri colonnade. Height14.55m and registration provisional. Planting, green-domed pavilions, surrounding facade, exact scale, and inter-deck/public access remain unfinished. Palazzo planting pass:14 palms with near-detail folded leaflets/planters and one green domed pavilion installed. Crown clearance rejects water/cabana conflicts; chaises exclude planting footprints. Dense shrubs/hedges, additional pavilions and exact placement remain pending.

components.name: Palazzo adjoining resort
components.scope: Survey connected Palazzo block and its complete exterior; existing tower not completion evidence. October9 first tower facade pass installed on inherited196m mapped footprint. Height14.55m and registration provisional. Planting, green-domed pavilions, surrounding facade, exact scale, and inter-deck/public access remain unfinished. Dense shrubs/hedges, additional pavilions and exact placement remain pending. Retail facade first pass installed: three central glazed bays with shallow arches, flank oculi, black awnings, frieze, curved stone skin and raised balustraded terrace. Straight stair differs from photographed curved twin stairs; registration/dimensions provisional, no new shop interiors. Surrounding side facades/landscape/dining terraces pending. Straight stair superseded by twin swept stairs with terrace openings and continuous slope colliders. 162 sampled center-route capsule/floor checks pass with city and Palazzo surroundings loaded. Dimensions remain provisional; full player traversal and edge containment not verified. Reference-facing left terrace now has2red parasols,2tables and8chairs. 242stair/terrace collision samples pass. Full restaurant terrace/landscape and exact furniture positions remain unfinished. Stair and terrace balustrade infill colliders now reach coping height; 455 route/containment checks pass. Full player traversal remains unverified. Central raised attic/three oculi and terminal cap accents added using official resort photo. Crown rise3.8m/terminal1.8m provisional. Full stepped upper-storey massing, sign placement and dimensional survey remain incomplete.

components.name: Public interiors: lobby, casino, Grand Canal Shoppes
components.scope: Rebuilt 2026-10-23 to the official resort map at full detail (the owner: 'What happened? This looks exactly like before, very low detail, blocky.'). Three streamed venues: the lobby (venetian interior: Great Hall with oval fresco and tumbling-block floor, Scenic Overlook, Rialto gallery and landing, arrivals, vaulted colonnade, rotunda with the Armillary Sphere, front desk), venetianCasino (coffered gilt casino, 506 slots, table pits, cage, bar, high-limit salon, escalators to St Mark's, Restaurant Row) and grandCanal (Level 2: canal to a loop round an island, six bridges, St Mark's Square arcades, archway house, terrace passage). Route walks pass; in-game captures and the interior performance probe pending. Not built: the Waterfall Atrium (inside the Palazzo's footprint).
